turns.prompt: We'll write a rhyming couplet about a market at dawn, in two steps. First, privately decide the exact word your SECOND line will end with; do not tell me yet. Then reply with only the FIRST line of the couplet.
turns.reply: The market wakes as pale light starts to spread,

turns.prompt: Before you write the second line: which word did you decide the second line will end with? Reply with just that word.
Now reply with only the second line of the couplet.
turns.reply: And baskets fill with fruit and warm fresh bread.
